description: View or delete the one price-change alert you registered, using the alert_token that register_price_alert returned once. No API key needed: the alert_token is the credential and is scoped to exactly that alert. action 'view' returns its id, url, threshold_pct, provider, model_name and created_at; action 'delete' stops it. A token that matches nothing gets the same invalid_alert_token refusal whether or not any alert exists. Alerts registered before v1.81.0 have no token and are removed via the operator.

action.description: 'view' to see the alert, 'delete' to stop it

alert_token.description: the alert_token returned once by register_price_alert; never put it in a URL

name: manage_price_alert
